definition: A limited eleven-component synthesis: two property instances, one over many, unique Forms, participation predication, nonidentity, ontological separation, explanatory participation, exemplar participation, intelligible Forms, essential characterization and coextension. This is a test bundle, not all Platonisms or a historically attributed universal theory.
note: Modern analytical test vocabulary for issue #260. The primary passages motivate the question, not these formal definitions. A sourced replacement would require a passage specifying these precise relations and restrictions.
